en.text:
Being within 15 meters of 3 Enemies grants #e${140*#d-100}% increased damage. Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once the condition is no longer met.

Exceptions:
• Swords only receive a #e${135*#d-100}% damage increase.
• Grenade and Rocket Launchers receive a #e${135*#d-100}% Explosive Damage increase and a #e${140*#d-100}% Impact Damage increase.
• Wolfpack Rounds receive a #e${135*#d-100}% Explosive Damage increase.
